progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on D# in Hodi. The line peaks at Gs4 (414.5 Hz) at 0:32.1. It closes on E4, not the tonic (E4 → F#4 → F#4 → Gs4 → F#4 → E4).
